candidateManifest.adapters: CLI and MCP share execute(); headless disk adapters serialize by fail-closed lab lock. They do not connect to the browser authority. No general IPC/grants/takeover implemented.
candidateManifest.histories: Per editing context, preserved across view detach; not persisted across host restart. Foreign accepted steps rebased via pinned collab plugin. Guard is an experiment, not accepted selective undo design.
candidateManifest.persistence: MemoryStore in tests, browser-only localStorage in UI, FileStore separate headless processes; never production app/vault. Node snapshot uses fsync/rename and directory fsync, not power-loss qualification.

profiles.control: Archived legacy table-key profile: CT-01 raw; CT-02 changes only selection preflight. Neither defines current table policy.
profiles.guarded: Default Context plus conservative history-guard.mjs; refuses foreign deletion/opaque overlap
profiles.keymap: src/browser.mjs: shared confirmed table-command.mjs; caret-end Tab/Shift-Tab, same-column Enter/bottom no-op, Shift-Enter hard break, final Tab no-op; explicit table-view handles. Mod-z/redo and Mod-b retain candidate history.
profiles.origin: Separate OriginAuthority accepted Y.Doc and per-context provisional replicas. y-prosemirror 1.3.7 sync/undo plugins, Yjs 13.6.33, no prosemirror-history plugin in this candidate. Remote deliveries have an untracked origin. No server/provider transport.
plugins: collab with explicit context origin and current version
profiles.raw: Unpatched pinned ProseMirror libraries; guard disabled explicitly in diagnostic test only
profiles.selection: Focused native TextSelection mapped through public posAtDOM before key commands; no timers/private observers; skip composition, node/cell model selections and nested controls
profiles.tablePolicy: table-interaction-contract.md confirmed 2026-11-14; origin structural handle history uses conservative public StackItem.meta guard after foreign changes; raw history control route retained.

candidateManifest.qualification: Exploratory targeted alternatives only. Raw controls remain failing. Full native/semantic/lifecycle/performance qualification is still blocked; see follow-up findings and separate evidence. The origin candidate has no persistence/CLI/MCP bridge.
candidateManifest.representations: Authority accepted doc; immutable engine caches/provisional input in contexts; snapshot/recovery records deliberately serialize protected copies.
candidateManifest.schema: src/schema.mjs; minimal R02-derived semantic subset, not canonical Clutter schema
candidateManifest.scope: Exploratory two-view candidates and native host source; native compilation/execution must be recorded separately
unsupported: task page projection and full task move/copy/delete/recurrence commands

manualCaseCatalog.expected: Two view-local modes: editing = highlighted cell plus caret; cell selection = highlighted cell without caret. Escape selects the current cell; Tab/Shift-Tab navigate selected cells; Enter resumes editing. Editing Enter moves down the same column. Final Tab never grows a table. Handles preserve the original cell/focus/mode. Record actual physical chords and failures; do not infer native pass from fixture checks.
steps: Reset using Fixture checks. Click Four: the cell is highlighted with a caret. Press Escape: the same cell stays selected/highlighted without a caret; focus does not move to a handle.
While the cell is selected, Tab/Shift-Tab move the highlight through existing cells without a caret. Enter resumes editing the selected cell. Check final Tab stays on the final cell.
While editing, Tab/Shift-Tab put a caret at the destination text end. Enter moves down the same column and does nothing at the bottom. Shift-Enter inserts an in-cell line break.
Add a row/column with its explicit handle; the original cell/caret or selected-cell mode remains active. Verify B matches content. Navigation never creates structure.
manualCaseCatalog.title: Confirmed table navigation and handles

manualCaseCatalog.expected: Origin candidate: undo leaves FOREIGNAlpha beta; redo restores abFOREIGNcdAlpha beta. Guarded step candidate may visibly refuse the unsafe batched inverse. Neither may silently delete B's text. These candidate outcomes are different; report what occurred.
steps: In A, paste abcd at the start of Alpha beta as one operation.
In B, paste FOREIGN between ab and cd as one operation. Return focus to A and use Command-Z, then Shift-Command-Z.
Also try ordinary typing and edits in different paragraphs.
manualCaseCatalog.title: Cross-view undo and redo

manualCaseCatalog.expected: One committed phrase at the intended caret, no duplicate/dropped characters or unintended structural command. Cancel follows native behaviour. Final X enters the intended editor. Synthetic composition events do not count.
steps: Select a real Japanese, Chinese or Korean macOS input source. Compose a short phrase in a paragraph and an empty table cell.
Choose a candidate with Enter; separately start another composition and cancel it with Escape.
Try Shift/arrow candidate navigation and then type X. Write down input source and phrase in Notes. Repeat available languages; mark unavailable ones blocked in Notes.
manualCaseCatalog.title: Real IME composition

manualCaseCatalog.expected: Menu and keyboard routes affect the focused editing context once, preserve the other view's edits, and return input to the intended caret. Disabled/unhandled menu commands are a failure or explicit blocker, not an automatic pass.
steps: Edit in A, then B. Use the macOS Edit menu with the pointer to Undo/Redo in each focused view.
Try the keyboard shortcuts too. Open and dismiss a menu, then immediately type.
Switch to the other candidate window and back; verify the intentionally focused view receives commands.
manualCaseCatalog.title: Native Edit menu and focus

manualCaseCatalog.expected: The intended range changes once; plain-style paste strips formatting. Undo restores content without affecting another origin. Clipboard contents themselves are not read by the harness reporter.
steps: Make a backward selection with the mouse, replace it, then undo.
Copy synthetic formatted text from TextEdit; use Edit > Paste and Paste and Match Style into a paragraph and a table cell.
Cut/paste plain synthetic text between A and B. Avoid task moves: their full lifecycle is not implemented in this comparison.
manualCaseCatalog.title: Native clipboard and selection

manualCaseCatalog.expected: Core controls and editing paths are discoverable, named and operable. The harness does not enable VoiceOver or infer accessibility success.
steps: Enable VoiceOver yourself with the macOS shortcut/settings. Navigate the fixture, table, toolbar and native checklist without the pointer.
Verify control names/state and a finite path into and out of the editor. Turn VoiceOver off when finished if desired.
Record any unnamed control, inaccessible operation or keyboard trap; mark blocked if VoiceOver cannot be tested.
manualCaseCatalog.title: VoiceOver and keyboard access

manualCaseCatalog.expected: No stale-range replacement or unwanted focus transfer. Reopened step view retains its context history. Candidate windows have independent authorities; this is not shared-document multi-window synchronization.
steps: Select text, format with the toolbar or Command-B, then immediately type.
Switch candidate windows during menu interaction; return to a chosen pane and type.
In the step candidate only, close and reopen view A while editing in B.
manualCaseCatalog.title: Focus after formatting and view reopen

manualCaseCatalog.expected: Accepted synthetic work survives in-page protected restart, or close refuses when neither path can protect it. This WKWebView uses an in-memory website store: quitting the native app is NOT an on-disk durability/crash-recovery test.
steps: Enable Fail saves, type synthetic text, then use Protect & restart inside the page.
Verify text remains. Enable Fail recovery as well and try Close view A.
Verify close is blocked; turn both switches off afterwards.
manualCaseCatalog.title: Save-failure protection (step candidate only)

manualCaseCatalog.expected: Triple-click selects all text in this cell, not the cell. The text selection stays in editing mode; replacement/undo preserve rows, columns and other cell content. Record the result manually with Pass/Fail/Blocked after testing.
steps: Reset using Fixture checks. Triple-click Four in the table. The cell text is selected; the whole cell is not in cell-selection mode.
Type X, then Command-Z: only the text changes to X and back to Four in both views; table structure stays unchanged. Repeat on multiline cell text when available.
manualCaseCatalog.title: Table triple-click selects text
